title: Divi Library portability export
description: Shape of a Divi Builder portability JSON (Divi Library layout / builder export) produced by the asset pipeline. Kept intentionally permissive (additionalProperties allowed) because Divi may add fields across versions; we validate the known keys' types so a malformed export fails CI early.

data.description: Map of numeric string ids -> Divi shortcode strings.

presets.description: Module global presets bundled with the export.

images.description: Base64/url image payloads keyed by hash.
